transaction_defects.description: The applicator set its coherent flag before deleting rollback images. If rollback deletion failed after partial cleanup, the exception path could preserve a mixed or uncertain state while finally removed the lock on the stale flag.
transaction_defects.required_correction: Treat installed-successor coherence separately from cleanup completion; never partially restore a coherent successor after cleanup failure; retain the lock and remaining evidence unless the exact successor or exact restored predecessor plus residue cleanup is proved.

transaction_defects.description: The applicator performed one cohort check before the install loop but did not recheck lock, target, stage, and rollback identities and payloads immediately before each os.replace.
transaction_defects.required_correction: Pin filesystem identities and payloads after lock acquisition and stage creation; recheck all installed and pending targets and owned transaction artifacts before each replacement; preserve third-state evidence.
